d:
The Vivo X500 isn't the Pro or the Pro Max. It's the vanilla flagship, but it might just be one of the most complete phones in its category.
With flagship prices climbing, does it still make sense to spend more on the Pro models? I've been using the X500 as my primary phone, and between its cameras, performance, massive battery and surprisingly few compromises, it makes a pretty compelling case for itself.
But is it actually worth buying?
